QuietRead · 静读\n\n点击「打开」或拖入本地 EPUB。用目录跳转:
QuietRead

Click “Open” or drop a local EPUB into the window. Use Contents to jump, the bottom buttons to turn pages and Search to find text.

“Aa” changes appearance, presets and book-specific settings. “Full screen” expands the reading area; “+ Bookmark” saves your position.

Select text to add highlights and notes. Library manages tags, reading status, backups and imports. Search supports chapter scope, case and whole words. Use “Retry save” if saving fails.

Choose Chinese or English under “Aa” → “Interface language”. Your choice is saved locally.

Reading data stays on this computer. QuietRead does not run book scripts or load external resources. It is designed for novels and general text books; DRM and fixed layout are not supported.
